text:
maria-cs: Heads-up — customer 'Orchid' reported Billing UI 403 after this morning's role-template rollout. They can list models fine but Billing > Invoices returns 403 when trying to export CSV. Raised at 09:17 PT.

rachel-support: Created internal ticket INC-4238 and flagged as customer-impacting. Pinging @alicia-eng, @ivan-sec, @chris-sre for triage.

alicia-eng: On it. Can you paste tenant id and a request id?

maria-cs: tenant: org-orchid, example request id: req_0a9b3c. Screenshot sent in DM.

ivan-sec: Sounds like a role-scope regression from the template squash we rolled at ~09:15. I'll check rbac-sync logs and the template resolver.

chris-sre: rbac-sync pod restarted at 09:20 during the deploy; it applied template bundle v2.4.4. Running quick check: `rbacctl check --tenant org-orchid --permission billing.view --subject user:orchid-admin`

alicia-eng: Output shows DENY. Quick inspect: `rbacctl roles --tenant org-orchid --format=json` indicates the binding for billing now points to `role_template: org-scoped-admin` instead of `workspace-billing`. Also seeing service-principal annotations like `redwood.org/scope=org` on some entries that should be workspace-scoped.

ivan-sec: That annotation should not have been set. Template resolver precedence looks wrong when merging org and workspace templates — likely caused service-principals to pick up org scope.

chris-sre: Snippet from rbac-sync logs around the time:
```
2026-04-12T16:20:12Z rbac-sync INFO applying template bundle v2.4.4
2026-04-12T16:20:13Z rbac-sync WARN template-resolver: attribute 'service-principal.scope' collision, using org-level value
2026-04-12T16:20:14Z permission_eval ERROR missing_role_binding workspace-billing: not found
```

rachel-support: Customer on call — "we need invoices export for month end" — marking high priority.

alicia-eng: Temporary mitigation: I'll add a workspace-scoped binding for the admin user so they can export. Command I'm going to run: `rbacctl bind --tenant org-orchid --role workspace-billing --subject user:orchid-admin --note "temp-fix-2026-04-12"`

chris-sre: Applied the binding at 09:29 PT. Verified: `rbacctl check --tenant org-orchid --permission billing.view --subject user:orchid-admin` now returns ALLOW. Maria, please ask customer to retry.

maria-cs: Customer confirms access restored at 09:32 PT. They were able to export CSV. I'm leaving the temp binding in place until we have a migration plan.

ivan-sec: Root cause summary: the role-template squash changed precedence rules in the resolver so org-level `service-principal.scope` could override workspace intent. We'll open a PR to add stricter validation (reject ambiguous scope merges) and an e2e test that covers service-principal scope inheritance. Also planning a one-off audit to find tenants affected between 09:10-09:22 PT.

alicia-eng: Created draft PR: github.com/redwood/rbac/pull/1298 (adds validation + test). Also preparing a migration script to remove the erroneous `redwood.org/scope=org` annotation from service principals created during the window. Script will run in audit mode first.

deploy-bot: incident created: SPT-2026-04-12-87, labels: [customer-impacting, severity:P2].

chris-sre: I'll run an audit query to enumerate impacted tenants: `SELECT tenant_id FROM bindings WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-04-12T16:10:00Z' AND '2026-04-12T16:22:00Z' AND attribute->>'service-principal.scope' = 'org'` and share results here.

rachel-support: Adding a postmortem stub under /docs/incidents/SPT-2026-04-12-87. Assigning owner: ivan-sec. Customer wants ETA for permanent fix.

ivan-sec: ETA for fix + reconciliation plan: 48 hours. Plan includes (1) PR review + merge, (2) run migration script in dry-run, (3) coordinate a non-disruptive cleanup window, (4) remove temp bindings where safe. Will include rollback steps and a ticket for manual review of high-priv tenants.

maria-cs: :thumbsup: I'll keep the customer updated and close INC-4238 once the migration run is complete and we confirm no other tenants impacted.

chris-sre: Follow-up action items: audit results, PR merge, migration dry-run, scheduled cleanup window, postmortem. Posting notes to the internal incident doc in 15m.
